title: Extraction evaluation harness (P/R/F1 vs gold + groundedness check)
context: An evaluation harness measures extraction quality against the gold set and reports the groundedness pass rate. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. The harness makes quality claims checkable and reproducible in CI.
objective: Build the extraction evaluation harness reporting P/R/F1 vs gold plus the groundedness pass rate.
acceptanceCriteria: Computes precision/recall/F1 of entity extraction + normalization against the gold set (gold-016).
Deterministic groundedness re-location check reports a pass rate; ungrounded outputs flagged.
Report format defined (entity-normalization F1, kappa reference, groundedness pass rate); tests + CI green; MIT; DCO signed-off.
